# Synthetic English input for tests/test_i18n.py. Nothing here is real.
# The step field words (beskrivelse, verktøy, varighet, forslag) are the spec language;
# the builder never writes them into the page. Only the values below show up.

title: How a request becomes a report
description: From a question to a file people open, and back again when something must change.
source: A made-up example for the i18n test
requested-by: The test suite

lane Requester
  start ask: Needs numbers to share
    beskrivelse: Someone has numbers to share with colleagues.
    input: A question and a spreadsheet
  step describe: Describes the question
    output: A clear audience
    verktøy: A short chat
    varighet: 10 minutes
lane Analyst
  step build: Builds the report
    improve: Often starts without an example
      problem: The first draft misses the point
      forslag: Ask for one example first
  decision ok: Approved?
  end done: Report shared

flow
  ask -> describe -> build -> ok
  ok -> build [no]
  ok -> done [yes]
